d: Political tension flared over Deepavali greetings after Bharatiya Janata Party leaders strongly criticized Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge for describing Deepavali as an "Eid of joy" while addressing reporters. BJP spokespersons Pradeep Bhandari and Gaurav Bhatia accused the Congress of practicing vote-bank appeasement and undermining Sanatan traditions by altering the identity of Hindu festivals. Challenging Rahul Gandhi and Kharge to describe Eid as a "Diwali of joy," the BJP questioned why the party hesitates to use the festival's actual name. In response, Congress MP Pawan Khera…
